parsed.explanation: No trans criminalisation, facility ban, or documented police targeting; same-sex conduct lawful since 1977, hate-crime law covers gender identity, and a travel guide reports wide acceptance. These positives are offset by documented uneven enforcement, inadequate hate-crime investigations, under-reporting, escalating anti-gender disinformation, and no shown effective remedy for visitors. Border documents, facilities, custody and care are unresolved open questions, not documented exposures, so they do not dominate.

entry_documents.interaction: No visa, passport-marker or entry evidence; cannot infer acceptance or rejection of foreign documents.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: 2026 analysis documents search difficulties for trans/gender-nonconforming persons by police, customs and courts, but no birth-sex mandate or abuse rate is stated.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Search law exists; whether it protects or exposes a detained visitor is unresolved.

federal_state_facilities.interaction: No bathroom, ward or public-facility restriction documented; absence is not proof of access.

care_services.exposure: Anti-discrimination provisions in health are reported as inconsistently enforced.
care_services.protection: Anti-discrimination law covers health on paper.
care_services.interaction: Paper protection without documented visitor-facing enforcement; no emergency-care denial documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Anti-gender disinformation escalating; parliamentary Gender Ideology session excluded LGBTI organisations; one coastal Pride faced disruption.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Same-sex conduct lawful since 1977; hate-crime legislation enumerates sexual orientation and gender identity; Pride and LGBT centres operate.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Formal protection coexists with political hostility and uneven implementation.

minors_guardians.interaction: Resident family/reproductive law is not counted as traveller exposure; no traveller-minor rule documented.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Under-reporting of homophobic/transphobic crime; hate-crime investigations flagged inadequate; public displays of affection may draw unwelcome responses in less-populated cities.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Prosecutor charged a man refusing a gay couple's booking, outcome not stated; travel guide reports wide acceptance.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Acceptance is documented, but response/recourse for trans-specific violence is not shown working.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Judiciary uneven, limited access to justice, victims reluctant to report; enforcement lags statute book.
remedies_unknowns.protection: External equality monitoring and a prosecution attempt show some machinery, not documented visitor remedy.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Entry, facilities, custody, care and complaint outcomes remain unknown and cannot be treated as safety.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar mixed acceptance with recurring hostility and inconsistent remedies, but no documented repeated visitor refusals at the 0.55 frequency; this dossier is somewhat safer.
Similar lawful setting with social friction and uneven police/court handling, but 0.65-A documents refunds, compliance and convictions; here remedies are not shown working, so lower.
0.75-C has documented identity-based facilities, enforced compensation and no organised targeting; this dossier lacks those operating protections, so materially lower despite no universal ban.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: generally tolerant, legally protective on paper, with Pride/centres and wide visitor acceptance, but enforcement and hate-crime investigation are documented as inadequate and anti-gender political activity is escalating. No tier-1 universal exposure or organised targeting is documented; the main traveller risk is thin/unproven recourse if harassment or discrimination occurs, plus unresolved border/search questions. That places it below the reduced-risk anchors with proven remedies but above elevated-risk anchors with recurring visitor-facing bans or targeting.
